note: One-time import of a run recorded on branch intelxeonbenchtables at 8f5b9bc, on an Intel Xeon E3-1240 v5 that is no longer available. Taken from the raw BenchmarkDotNet artifacts committed there; recordedAt is that commit's date. Two reports from that era were left out: KmacIncremental and KmacOutputSize. The first has no algorithm/variant breakdown in its Description, so it parses to a family that is really an escaped method name; the second varies output size, an axis this schema cannot express, so 12 of its 16 rows collapse onto 4 keys. Both remain on the intelxeonbenchtables branch. kmac128 and kmac256 are kept but contribute no rows - the parser already declines that era's flat-token KMAC descriptions.
